gaps.explanation: Schedule is 157,164 above the statement. Re-read p4 (governmental funds statement, cash basis), p8 (General Fund budget and actual, not in detail: the p11 combining schedule holds the same General Fund money by department), p9 (Bond Fund budget and actual) and p11 (General Fund combining schedule). The statement prints Total disbursements 665,472 (General column; Bond column '-') and prints the Bond Fund 'Debt service (157,163)' under OTHER FINANCING SOURCES (USES) (in JSON other_financing -81,856 = Grants and donations 75,307 + Debt service (157,163)). The Bond Fund schedule (p9) prints the same money among DISBURSEMENTS: Debt service - principal 139,849 + Debt service - interest 17,134 + Other 180 = 157,163 (detail, section expenditure). The p11 department lines add to 665,473 vs printed Total disbursements 665,472 (the report's own rounding). 665,473 + 157,163 = 822,636 = schedule total; 822,636 - 665,472 = 157,164. Every printed row is in detail[] once; the statement and the schedule classify the Bond Fund debt service differently. No fix.

Schedule is 2,110 short. JSON business-type receipts are from the accrual Statement of Revenues, Expenses and Change in Net Position - Proprietary Funds (p6): Utility sales Water 197,264 + Sewer 202,833 = 400,098 + Interest income 836 = 400,934. Detail holds the proprietary funds' own printed cash-basis schedule (p10, 'Actual (Budgetary Basis)'): Utility sales 397,988 + Interest income 836 = 398,824. 400,098 - 397,988 = 2,110 = p7 cash flows '(In)decrease in accounts receivable' Total (2,110) (Water 1,565 + Sewer 545): cash collections vs accrual sales. The p6 fund-column rows are not added: their money is already in the p10 lines (double count). No fix.

Schedule is 16,230 short. p6 (accrual) operating expense rows (Water 164,764 + Sewer 127,405; Total-column rows add to 292,170 vs printed 292,169) including Depreciation and amortization 142,795, + Interest expense 40,332 = 332,502. p10 cash-basis schedule (detail): Personnel expenses 78,538 + Operating expenses 81,470 + Debt service 156,264 = 316,272 (no depreciation; debt service as cash payment; p10 also prints 'Transfers to other funds' (156,264) inside disbursements, recorded in detail as other financing +156,264). Adding the p6 fund columns would double count the p10 lines. 332,502 - 316,272 = 16,230 is a basis difference, not a missing printed line. No fix.
